title: Green beans, canned, reduced sodium, cooked, fat added, NS as to fat type

content.title: About
content.content: Canned green beans are a ready‑to‑eat vegetable that has been heat‑processed and sealed in a can with reduced sodium. A vegetable oil is added, but the specific type of fat is not specified (NS). The beans retain most of their nutrients, have a tender texture, and a mildly sweet flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green beans belong to the legume family and are rich in protein and fiber.
Canning allows the beans to be stored for several years without loss of flavor.
Reduced sodium is achieved by replacing part of the salt with other flavor enhancers.
Added oil improves the absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins A and K.
In the US and Canada, canned green beans are often used in ready‑made dishes such as chili and stews.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Fiber supports normal digestion and helps maintain a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Source of vitamin A
items.content: Vitamin A is essential for vision, immune function, and skin health.

items.title: Contains vitamin K
items.content: Vitamin K plays a role in blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Low sodium
items.content: Reduced salt content is beneficial for blood pressure management.

items.title: Added plant fats
items.content: The added oil aids the absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins and provides energy.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to beans.

items.title: Fat content
items.content: The product contains added fats, which may be undesirable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Bacterial contamination after opening
items.content: Once the can is opened, store the beans in the refrigerator and consume within a few days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Green beans can be eaten straight from the can, added to salads, soups, stews, or used as a side dish. Before serving, drain the liquid and, if desired, rinse with cold water.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened cans in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the beans in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑5 days.
